rules: Historical claims are not edited. Claims whose value is unchanged in the corrected run keep their ID and are re-pointed to the corrected run, with the value checked against the corrected results.json. The active ledger uses only the harness kinds measurement, literature and interpretation; provenance and historical records are kept in this file.

Arm A M5 natural-unknown false acceptance at OP-cov was 0.30 (6/20) in the original unseeded fit and 0.15 (3/20) in the unseeded fit of the failed reproduction.

records.text: The historical M5 fits were unseeded; two unseeded fits on identical inputs differed beyond the pre-specified per-cell tolerances and in their natural-unknown counts; the results of record now use seed 0. The cause was not isolated beyond the missing seed, and three fits do not estimate seed variance.
records.limitations: Other contributors (n_jobs=4 one-vs-rest parallelism, BLAS threading, unrecorded historical environment) were not excluded. Whether seed 0 makes the M5 fits repeatable within tolerance is tested only by the seed-controlled reproduction, which was pending at authorship.
